role: The full CI workflow ("CI"): manual-only (workflow_dispatch with scope gates|unit|full and optional baseline-ref) and reusable (workflow_call, scope default full) so testflight.yml gates releases on it. Four jobs: lint-and-budgets (macOS, every static gate), strict-concurrency (ubuntu), thread-sanitizer and tests (macOS, skipped for gates scope).
toplevel: Triggers: workflow_dispatch only (no push/PR/schedule) and workflow_call. Top-level permissions contents:read; concurrency cancels an in-flight run on the same workflow+ref (when called from testflight.yml, github.workflow is the caller's name). Scope gates runs lint-and-budgets + strict-concurrency only; unit adds TSan and the unit test target (overall/logic coverage floors not gated, Views floor gated); full adds the UI target and the coverage floors. scripts/simulate_ci.sh (make ci-local) parses this file to replay it locally, and scripts/check_gates_wired.sh requires every check_/enforce_ script name to appear in it. Since nothing triggers it automatically, every gate that exists only here runs only when someone dispatches it or deploys to TestFlight. lint-and-budgets installs SwiftLint pinned by version and checksum.

units.does: `brew install ripgrep`, then downloads SwiftLint's portable_swiftlint.zip for the pinned SWIFTLINT_VERSION (0.65.1) from the realm/SwiftLint GitHub release with curl (fail on HTTP error, 3 retries) into $RUNNER_TEMP, verifies it against the pinned SWIFTLINT_SHA256 with `shasum -a 256 -c` (mismatch fails the step), unzips it, checks that `swiftlint version` prints exactly the pinned version (else exit 1), and prepends its directory to $GITHUB_PATH so later steps run that binary. The header comment ties the pin to the exact-count .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt: bump version and checksum together and re-measure the budget.

units.does: Computes the budget baseline: inputs.baseline-ref if given, else HEAD~1 if it exists, else HEAD if .ci has uncommitted changes, else emits empty value/require and exits 0. Verifies the ref resolves to a commit (else exit 1), then writes value=<sha> and require=1 to $GITHUB_OUTPUT. A comment notes that a manual run compares one commit and that gates.yml, run on every push to main against the tip before the push, is what keeps every commit reaching main inside some compared range.

branches.effect: choose a default (next branches); otherwise use the given ref

branches.cond: root commit and `git diff --quiet HEAD -- .ci` reports changes
branches.effect: baseline = HEAD (working tree compared); else outputs value= and require= empty, prints root-commit message and exits 0 so the next step skips without failing

branches.cond: chosen ref does not resolve to a commit
branches.effect: print refusal and exit 1 (job fails); else output value and require=1

units.does: Runs scripts/check_budget_monotonicity.sh with BUDGET_BASE_REF/BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE from the baseline step: compares every numeric .ci/*.txt (whole or decimal, including min_coverage_views.txt) present in the tree or at the baseline, and fails on a raised ceiling, a lowered min_* floor, or a deleted or non-numeric budget not acknowledged by a budget-raise-ok trailer in BASE..HEAD; with require=1 an unresolvable baseline fails instead of skipping.
